title: calotheca littoralis
intro: Calotheca littoralis, commonly known as Blue Mauve, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that may help to alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Calotheca littoralis include its sedative and calming properties, which can help to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Calotheca littoralis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
